This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into on this ___ day of __________, 20__, by and between:

**[Employer Name]**, a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at [Employer Address], Telangana, India  
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employer"),

**AND**

**[Employee Name]**, residing at [Employee Address], Telangana, India  
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").

Collectively referred to as the "Parties".

---

### 1. **APPOINTMENT**  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of **UI Engineer**, and the Employee accepts such appointment, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

---

### 2. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  
The Employee shall perform the duties and responsibilities customary to the role of a UI Engineer, including but not limited to designing and implementing user interface components, collaborating with development teams, ensuring responsive and accessible design, and maintaining technical documentation. The Employee shall report to the designated supervisor and perform all lawful and reasonable instructions assigned by the Employer.

---

### 3. **WORKPLACE**  
The primary place of work shall be the Employer’s office located in **Telangana, India**. The Employee shall work on an **on-site basis** and shall not be permitted to work remotely unless explicitly authorized in writing by the Employer.

---

### 4. **SALARY AND COMPENSATION**  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 1,900,000 (Indian Rupees Seventeen Lakh Ninety Thousand Only)**, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s payroll schedule. This amount constitutes the Employee’s fixed compensation and is subject to applicable statutory deductions, including but not limited to income tax, Provident Fund, and Professional Tax.

No additional compensation, bonuses, or benefits are guaranteed under this Agreement unless separately approved in writing by the Employer.

---

### 5. **PROBATION PERIOD**  
The Employee shall undergo a probationary period of **six (6) months** from the date of joining. During this period, the performance and suitability of the Employee shall be evaluated. The Employer reserves the right to terminate the employment during probation with **fourteen (14) days’ written notice** or pay in lieu thereof, without assigning any reason. Upon successful completion of the probation, the Employee’s position may be confirmed at the discretion of the Employer.

---

### 6. **WORKING TIME**  
The normal working hours shall be **thirty-eight (38) hours per week**, to be scheduled in accordance with the Employer’s operational requirements. The Employee may be required to work additional hours as necessary to fulfill job responsibilities, subject to compliance with applicable labor laws.

---

### 7. **LEAVE**  
The Employee shall be entitled to leave in accordance with the applicable statutory provisions, including but not limited to the **Andhra Pradesh Shops and Establishments Act, 1988** (as applicable to Telangana), and any rules framed thereunder. Leave entitlements, including earned leave, sick leave, and public holidays, shall be administered in line with statutory requirements and the Employer’s leave policy, as may be amended from time to time.

---

### 8. **STATUTORY BENEFITS**  
The Employee shall be entitled to benefits under applicable Indian labor laws, including but not limited to:  
- Employees’ Provident Fund and Pension Scheme (EPF & EPS),  
- Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), where applicable,  
- Maternity Benefit (as per the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961),  
- Gratuity (as per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972), upon fulfilling eligibility criteria.  

The Employer shall comply with all statutory obligations in relation to deductions, contributions, and filings.

---

### 9. **CONFIDENTIALITY**  
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose or use any confidential information, trade secrets, or proprietary data of the Employer, except as required in the course of authorized duties or as permitted by law. This obligation shall continue after termination of employment, to the extent permitted by law.

---

### 10. **INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY**  
All intellectual property, including but not limited to software, designs, code, documentation, and inventions, created by the Employee during the course of employment and relating to the Employer’s business shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee shall execute all necessary documents to assign such rights to the Employer, as required.

---

### 11. **WORKPLACE POLICIES**  
The Employee shall comply with all workplace policies, codes of conduct, safety regulations, and procedures established by the Employer from time to time, including those relating to data security, IT usage, and anti-harassment. Any violation may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

---

### 12. **TERMINATION**  
Either Party may terminate this Agreement by providing **forty-five (45) days** of prior written notice to the other Party, or by paying salary in lieu of the unexpired portion of the notice period. The Employer reserves the right to terminate employment summarily for cause, including misconduct, breach of policy, or violation of law, in accordance with applicable law.

Upon termination, the Employee shall return all company property, documents, and access credentials.

---

### 13. **DISPUTE RESOLUTION**  
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in **Telangana, India**. The Parties agree to first attempt resolution through good-faith discussions before initiating legal proceedings.

---

### 14. **GOVERNING LAW**  
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, including applicable employment statutes and regulations in force in Telangana.

---

### 15. **MISCELLANEOUS**  
- This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions or agreements.  
- Any amendments must be in writing and signed by both Parties.  
- If any provision is found invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force.  
- The Employee acknowledges having read, understood, and accepted all terms herein.

---

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

---

Designation: [Designation]  
Date: _______________  

**Employee:**  
_________________________  
Name: [Employee Name]  
Date: _______________
